zh-CN.title: 等级图鉴展开成长长卷
items: 等级图鉴改为连续的成长长卷，完整展示每一级的真实奖励；桌面端采用宽屏沉浸式侧栏，手机端保持自然的单列旅程

en.title: A new growth scroll for the level atlas
items: The level atlas now unfolds as a continuous journey with every real reward, using a wide immersive drawer on desktop and a natural single-column scroll on mobile
